visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed rotating hero at the top of the home page, one promoted story per slide
visualCharacteristics.description: Hero carousel: Full-bleed photo slides, white content box overlapping bottom-left of image with heading, text and yellow CTA; dot indicators and prev/next arrows.

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide; cell 1 = slide image (with alt), cell 2 = h2 title, description paragraph and CTA link

cells.name: content_text
cells.content: h2 title, description paragraph, CTA link

usage: Home page hero carousel (https://wknd.site/us/en.html): 3 slides - WKND Adventures, San Diego Surf Spots, Downhill Skiing Wyoming.
reuseGuidance: Use for a rotating set of full-bleed image slides with an overlaid text box and CTA. A single row renders as a static hero without controls.
